The results suggest that reusable weight programs can install and accumulate capabilities more effectively than simply copying fixed weight edits.

zh.title: 用可复用的权重程序，为训练好的模型持续安装新能力
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出权重空间编程（WSP）：让可执行程序直接读取、构造或修改神经网络权重，从而为训练好的模型安装新能力。其框架 WeightCode 使用冻结的语言模型编写这些程序，无需基于梯度的训练；安装后的能力也能独立运行，不再依赖语言模型。实验显示，这种方法能让模型掌握新的指令组合、动作和图像鲁棒性，同时保留原有能力，并在特定图像分类任务上优于多种微调方法。研究还发现，可复用的权重程序能迁移到其他独立训练的视觉 Transformer，并逐步叠加新能力，而直接复制固定的权重改动效果很弱。

papers.title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
papers.abstract: Abstract Auditing reward labels in coding-agent reinforcement learning tasks shows many unsolved tasks are mislabeled, and training on corrected tasks improves policy performance on SWE-bench benchmarks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.

ru.title: Низкий pass rate не значит, что награда верна: проверяйте метки!
ru.desc: Авторы проверяют корректность наград (reward labels) в задачах для обучения coding-агентов через reinforcement learning на SWE-Gym. Они обнаружили, что задачи, которые 9B-модель никогда не решает, часто содержат ошибочные тесты, отвергающие правильные исправления (false negatives: 74% против 20% у задач, которые решаются иногда). Очищенный и отремонтированный набор данных при одинаковом размере и сложности даёт прирост на 2.4 и 2.7 пункта на SWE-bench Verified и SWE-bench Pro. Также выяснено, что неверные патчи, проходящие тесты (false positives), составляют около четверти всех прошедших патчей, а новые тесты не дают заметного улучшения метрик, поэтому авторы выпускают SWE-Gym-Verified с 1087 проверенными задачами и полным пайплайном аудита.

en.title: Better Rewards, Better Coding Agents
en.desc: The paper audits reward labels in SWE-Gym, a collection of software tasks used to train coding agents with reinforcement learning. It finds that many tasks the model never solves have false-negative tests that reject correct fixes, and that repairing or removing these tasks improves policy performance. At equal training-set size and difficulty, models trained on the audited tasks score higher on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro, while simply dropping never-solved tasks does not produce the same gain. The results show that reward labels must be checked for correctness, not just measured by task pass rates; the authors release the audited dataset and evidence.

zh.title: 先审准奖励标签，再训练更强代码智能体
zh.desc: 本文研究代码智能体强化学习任务中的奖励标签是否正确，并审计了 SWE-Gym 数据集。研究发现，基础模型完全做不出的任务中，有 74% 的测试会错误拒绝正确修复，属于假阴性。修复或移除这些错误任务后，在数据规模和难度相当的条件下，训练出的策略在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上分别提升了 2.4 和 2.7 分；单纯删除做不出的任务则没有类似提升。研究还发现，测试通过率并不能说明奖励标签正确，因此作者发布了包含 1,087 个已审计任务及执行证据的数据集和审计流程。

papers.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Abstract A dual-agent framework with hierarchical memory and recursive self-improvement enables robotic manipulation agents to convert execution evidence into reusable guidance without updating model parameters.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Робот учится на собственном опыте, не меняя свою модель
ru.desc: Статья предлагает Embodied-Harness, двухагентную систему, где Actor взаимодействует с роботом через интерфейс управления, а Reflector преобразует данные выполнения в пригодные для повторного использования инструкции. Иерархическая память (short-term и long-term) хранит контекст и накопленный опыт, а Evidence-based Experience Reflection обосновывает диагностику ошибок наблюдаемыми взаимодействиями. Рекурсивное самоулучшение harness уточняет операционные инструкции между попытками, без обновления параметров VLM-модели. Метод показывает успех 82.4%, 76.7% и 94.4% на RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA и RMBench, а в реальных экспериментах средний успех составил 96.7%.

en.title: Robots That Learn from Experience—Without Retraining
en.desc: Embodied-Harness uses two agents to improve robotic manipulation without changing the model’s parameters. The Actor controls the robot, while the Reflector analyzes interaction evidence and turns lessons into reusable guidance. Hierarchical memory stores immediate context and longer-term experience, and recursive refinement updates that guidance over repeated attempts. The framework performs well across simulated benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, including when environments vary or tasks require planning and spatial reasoning.

zh.title: 让机器人从每次操作中积累经验，持续改进执行策略
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 Embodied-Harness，一个用于机器人操作的双智能体框架，不需要更新模型参数也能改进执行效果。Actor 负责通过控制接口与环境交互，Reflector 则依据执行证据分析问题，并整理可复用的操作建议。框架通过分层记忆保存短期执行信息和长期经验，并以递归方式持续修订这些建议。实验显示，该方法在多个基准测试和真实机器人任务中取得较高成功率，有助于应对环境变化、空间推理和长时程规划。

papers.title: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Abstract  Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/
affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

ru.title: Роботы учатся двуручной ловкости, сохраняя контакт руки с объектом
ru.desc: Статья представляет DexDuet — фреймворк, который обучает двуручную ловкость роботических рук по одной демонстрации человека с сохранением контактов. Основная идея в том, что простого отслеживания траектории объекта недостаточно, поэтому вводятся два интерактивных reward, сохраняющих конфигурацию руки относительно объекта и контакты. Двуручная политика факторизуется на две политики для каждой руки с разделяемыми весами, которые учитывают состояние друг друга. Адаптивный curriculum (A-RSI) регулирует помощь с объектом и стартовые состояния по сегментам демонстрации, а на четырёх бенчмарках DexDuet улучшает ADD-AUC на 11–41 пункт и лучше сохраняет контакты.

en.title: Learn the Motion, Keep the Contact
en.desc: DexDuet learns bimanual robot manipulation from a single human demonstration while preserving how the hands contact the object. It uses interaction rewards to maintain human-like hand-object configurations and contact points. Its coordinated policy consists of two weight-sharing per-hand policies that use information about each other’s states, while assisted reference-state initialization adapts training difficulty. Across benchmarks, DexDuet improves object tracking and preserves contacts more reliably than the baselines.

zh.title: 不只跟踪物体，更要学会双手如何接触
zh.desc: 本文提出 DexDuet，让机器人通过单次人类示范学习双手灵巧操作。它使用两种交互奖励，保留人手与物体的相对姿态和接触关系，减少抓错位置或手指滑动。它将双手策略拆分为两个共享权重、并能根据另一只手状态作出反应的单手策略，并用自适应课程 A-RSI 帮助训练应对困难阶段。在多种仿真器和机器人形态的测试中，DexDuet 提升了物体轨迹跟踪表现，也更常保持示范中的接触方式。

papers.title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
papers.abstract: Abstract  Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both interactive worlds and the tasks agents must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation (WD). World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. Explicit states and tool-call traces support task validation and agent evaluation. We evaluate 22 models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 88.8% mean Pass@1. Construction experiments demonstrate token efficiency and expansion of task coverage. At the richest knowledge level, WD fully covers 22/23 properties, 19/29 functionalities, and 30/39 event requirements specified in a real RobotVacuum protocol. Furthermore, the 1,000 sampled tasks semantically cover 81.6% of the 854 reference instructions in the real-world corpus. SynthDCB connects an expanding space of real-to-sim executable capabilities to verifiable agent evaluation.

ru.title: Проверяемая оценка агентов управления устройствами через дистилляцию мира
ru.desc: Статья представляет SynthDCB — бенчмарк для оценки LLM-агентов в задачах управления устройствами, включающий умные дома, автомобили и телефоны. Ключевой метод — world distillation, который превращает знания о поведении устройств, ограничениях и эффектах среды в модульные исполняемые компоненты. Единое представление возможностей связывает поиск инструментов, симуляцию среды и синтез задач, а явные состояния и трассы вызовов функций позволяют верифицировать результаты. Авторы оценили 22 модели на 2560 тестовых задачах, лучший результат — 88.8% Pass@1, а покрытие реального протокола и корпуса инструкций демонстрирует практическую применимость подхода.

en.title: Distill Real-World Device Knowledge into Verifiable Agent Tests
en.desc: SynthDCB is a benchmark for testing whether AI agents understand device environments and can control devices through tools. It uses world distillation to turn knowledge about device behavior, constraints, and environmental effects into reusable, executable components. The benchmark covers home, car, and phone settings, with explicit states and tool-call traces that help validate tasks and measure agent performance. In tests of 22 models, the best achieved 88.8% mean Pass@1, while construction experiments showed that the benchmark can efficiently expand its task coverage.

zh.title: 把真实设备知识蒸馏成可验证的控制基准
zh.desc: 本文提出 SynthDCB，这是一个用于评估智能体环境理解与设备控制能力的基准。它通过“世界蒸馏”将设备行为、限制和环境影响整理成可执行模块，并连接工具发现、环境运行和任务生成。基准涵盖家庭、汽车和手机等场景，包含 114 类设备、1,166 个功能、95 种事件，以及五大类任务，并通过明确状态和工具调用轨迹验证任务与评估模型。作者在 2,560 个测试任务上评估了 22 个模型，最佳模型的平均 Pass@1 为 88.8%，实验也显示该方法能节省构建成本并扩大任务覆盖范围。

papers.title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Abstract A hierarchical memory system using a vision-language model to select keyframes and an executor to act on them improves long-horizon robotic manipulation by retaining sparse visual details.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details. We study visual moment memory, the ability to retain such details from key moments for subsequent manipulation. To support this study, we introduce VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring memory of spatial locations, visual appearances, and their associations. We further propose MomentMem, a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories. This separation enables us to evaluate memory selection alongside closed-loop task success and to study memorizer generalization independently of the executor. On VMBench, MomentMem achieves 49.9% average success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 31.7 percentage points. Moreover, we find that the memorizer transfers well to unseen appearances zero-shot. It can also adapt to an unseen task with only a few memory annotations, reaching 43.7% success, close to the 44.3% obtained with full memory supervision. Further experiments show competitive performance on RMBench and improvements in real-robot manipulation. These results highlight the value of retaining sparse visual evidence for memory-dependent manipulation. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MomentMem.
affiliations: Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
State Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence, Peking University

ru.title: Помнить главное: разреженные визуальные кадры делают роботов точнее в долгих задачах
ru.desc: Статья посвящена проблеме памяти в роботизированных манипуляциях, где для выполнения длинных задач нужно помнить визуальные детали, которые уже не видны, например исходное положение объекта. Авторы вводят понятие visual moment memory и бенчмарк VMBench, а также иерархическую архитектуру MomentMem, где VLM-based memorizer выбирает ключевые кадры, а executor предсказывает действия на их основе. Такое разделение позволяет оценивать качество отбора памяти отдельно от успеха выполнения и исследовать генерализацию memorizer на неизвестные внешние виды и задачи. Метод показывает 49.9% средней успешности на VMBench, что на 31.7 п.п. выше лучшего базового подхода, и хорошо переносится на новые задачи при небольшом количестве аннотаций.

en.title: Remember the moments that move the task forward
en.desc: The paper studies how robots can remember important visual details, such as where an object was, after those details are no longer visible. It introduces VMBench, a benchmark for long-horizon manipulation tasks that require remembering locations, appearances, and their relationships. Its MomentMem architecture uses a vision-language model to select keyframes as memories, then an executor uses those memories to predict actions. MomentMem achieves 49.9% average success on VMBench, transfers to unseen appearances, and adapts to new tasks with only a few memory annotations.

zh.title: 记住关键视觉瞬间，让机器人完成更长程的操作
zh.desc: 本文研究机器人如何记住已经看不到的视觉信息，例如物体原来的位置和外观，以完成长程操作任务。作者提出 VMBench，用于评测机器人对空间位置、视觉外观及其关联的记忆能力。作者还提出 MomentMem：由视觉语言模型（VLM）选择关键帧作为记忆，再由执行器依据这些记忆预测动作，从而保留精简而重要的视觉证据。在 VMBench 上，MomentMem 的平均成功率达到 49.9%，比最强对比基线高 31.7 个百分点，并能迁移到未见外观和新任务。

papers.title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
papers.abstract: Abstract GameDojo is a controllable benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories, showing frontier models struggle in real-time interaction while training GameDojo-4B achieves frontier performance and policy transfer across bosses.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and our code is at https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo .
affiliations: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: GameDojo: тренировочный полигон для интерактивного интеллекта в реальном времени
ru.desc: Авторы представляют GameDojo — контролируемый интерактивный бенчмарк из 120 боссов в 20 играх, на основе которого оцениваются возможности LLM, алгоритмы обучения и агентные harness. Кодовые агенты восстанавливают игровые среды и пишут скрипты геймплея, в результате чего появляется набор GameDojo-Data с 600 часами траекторий. Эксперименты показывают, что передовые модели сильно затрудняются в задачах взаимодействия в реальном времени. Модель GameDojo-4B, обученная на этих данных, достигает уровня передовых моделей и лучше всех справляется с real-time взаимодействием, а также демонстрирует перенос выученной политики между боссами.

en.title: Train on GameDojo, Learn to Play Across Bosses
en.desc: GameDojo is a benchmark for testing how well AI agents handle 120 boss encounters across 20 games. It includes 600 hours of gameplay trajectories collected using reconstructed game environments and gameplay scripts. Experiments show that leading models struggle with real-time interaction, while training on this data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier-level performance. Joint training improves performance across tasks, and learned policies can transfer between bosses.

zh.title: 以海量游戏轨迹训练智能体，突破实时交互挑战
zh.desc: 论文提出了 GameDojo，一个包含 20 款游戏、120 场 Boss 战的可控交互式游戏基准，用于评估模型、学习算法和智能体系统。研究者通过编写游戏脚本构建了包含 600 小时游戏轨迹的 GameDojo-Data。实验显示，前沿模型在实时交互中仍面临很大挑战，而使用这些数据训练的 GameDojo-4B 达到了前沿水平，并取得了最强的实时表现。联合训练能提升各项任务的表现，训练得到的策略也能迁移到不同的 Boss 战中。

papers.title: A Pipeline-Parallel System for Depth-Recurrent Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Loop-PP schedules cyclic pipeline stages for depth-recurrent models, overlapping communication and compute while preserving exact numerical equivalence, reducing memory and increasing throughput on MoE models.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Depth-recurrent (Looped) models raise effective depth by applying a shared stack of blocks several times. Scaling them usually requires pipeline parallelism, but commonly used interleaved 1F1B is drawn for an acyclic stage graph in which each micro-batch enters each stage once. Once that stack is split across stages, the same stage is visited several times on one micro-batch and later stages feed earlier ones: native 1F1B has no slot for the extra visit, cannot rank a first iteration against a second, and its neighbour-only send/receive order has no back edge to the first stage, so the arrangement stalls or fires out of order. We present Loop-PP, which rebuilds both the timetable and the communication for this cyclic layout. It schedules different iterations of the same stage separately, specializes a 1F1B skeleton into a globally consistent order over those visits, and emits a static instruction stream per rank that separates posting from waiting so communication overlaps local compute. Loop-PP is bit-identical to a single-stage reference. On 8B-60B MoE models, it lowers peak memory by as much as 32.8\%, and with compute budget fixed, the best observed throughput rises by 12.7\%.

ru.title: Циклы без простоя: конвейер, который умеет возвращаться назад
ru.desc: Статья представляет Loop-PP — новый способ распределения рекуррентных моделей глубины (Looped models) по стадиям pipeline parallelism, где один и тот же блок применяется несколько раз. Классический interleaved 1F1B рассчитан на ациклический граф стадий, поэтому при циклическом проходе micro-batch он не может корректно упорядочить итерации и приводит к зависаниям или неверному порядку. Loop-PP перестраивает расписание, разделяя итерации одной стадии и выстраивая глобально согласованный порядок, а также генерирует статический поток инструкций, где отправка и ожидание данных разделены, что позволяет перекрывать коммуникацию с локальными вычислениями. Метод численно идентичен однostadийной эталонной реализации, а на MoE-моделях от 8B до 60B параметров снижает пиковое потребление памяти до 32.8% и повышает пропускную способность до 12.7% при фиксированном бюджете вычислений.

en.title: A smarter pipeline for looping models: less memory, more throughput
en.desc: Loop-PP is a pipeline-parallel scheduling method for depth-recurrent models, which reuse the same blocks multiple times. Unlike standard interleaved 1F1B, it handles the repeated visits to stages and the backward links between stages in the cyclic pipeline. It creates a globally ordered schedule and static communication instructions that let communication overlap with computation. The method preserves bit-for-bit numerical results, reduces peak memory by up to 32.8%, and increases throughput by up to 12.7% in the reported MoE experiments.

zh.title: 为循环流水线排好每一步，让通信计算并行、性能更高
zh.desc: 深度循环模型会多次重复使用同一组网络模块，以增加模型的有效深度。常见的 1F1B 流水线调度针对无环结构设计，无法正确安排同一批数据对同一阶段的多次访问，也难以处理回传通信。Loop-PP 为这种循环结构重新设计全局调度顺序和通信指令，让通信能与计算重叠，并保持与单阶段参考实现完全相同的数值结果。在 8B 至 60B 的 MoE 模型上，它最多降低 32.8% 的峰值内存，并在固定计算预算下将最佳吞吐量提高 12.7%。

papers.title: Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Hindsight Twins improves text-to-image alignment by distilling the velocity difference between twin prompt revisions while avoiding critic-induced bias.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.

ru.title: Учимся на ошибках, не копируя лишнего: разница близнецов вместо переписанной сцены
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод Hindsight Twins (HinT) для улучшения соответствия текста и изображения в text-to-image моделях. Вместо self-teacher, который обучается на переписанном критиком промпте и перенимает лишние детали сцены, HinT создаёт два «близнеца» шаблона: с нужной правкой и с наблюдаемой ошибкой. Модель дистиллирует только разницу их velocity, а токены вне правленого слота выравниваются между близнецами. Эксперименты на Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M и FLUX.2-klein показывают, что смещение от критика остаётся на уровне базовой модели, а улучшение сохраняется за двенадцать раундов самообучения, тогда как контрастные базовые подходы деградируют.

en.title: Learn from the fix, not the critic’s extra details
en.desc: Hindsight Twins (HinT) improves text-to-image alignment by teaching a model from the difference between two versions of a prompt: one containing the intended fix and one containing the observed error. Unlike earlier self-distillation methods, HinT anchors this comparison to the user's original prompt, helping avoid extra scene details introduced by a vision-language critic. It also aligns the text representations of tokens outside the edited span, reducing unintended effects from changes to one prompt slot. Experiments show that HinT matches or exceeds prior alignment improvements, keeps critic-induced bias near the base model's level, and continues improving over repeated training rounds.

zh.title: 只蒸馏修正差异，让文生图对齐更准
zh.desc: Hindsight Twins（HinT）是一种提升文生图模型文本对齐能力的自蒸馏方法。它把批评模型指出的错误位置分别填入“预期修正”和“实际错误”，并以用户原始提示词为基础，只蒸馏两种条件下预测速度的差异。为避免修正内容影响提示词其他部分，HinT还对齐两个版本中错误位置之外的词元表示。在多个模型上的实验表明，HinT能提升对齐效果，同时将批评模型引入的无关偏差控制在基础模型水平，并能在多轮自训练中持续改进。

papers.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

ru.title: Агенты, которые сами куют себе инструменты
ru.desc: Авторы представляют ToolSmith — фреймворк, который автоматически генерирует и переиспользует инструменты для мультимодальных поисковых LLM-агентов. Обычно такие агенты опираются на небольшой набор заранее написанных вручную инструментов поиска и визуального анализа, который трудно поддерживать и который не справляется с новыми типами запросов. ToolSmith расширяет базовую библиотеку, собирая новые модули из уже имеющихся компонентов, как это делают практики. Эксперименты на 13 бенчмарках с протоколом VLM-as-a-Judge показывают стабильное улучшение, причём с ростом размера бэкбона выигрыш увеличивается.

en.title: Build New Search Tools from Familiar Pieces
en.desc: ToolSmith is a framework that automatically creates and reuses tools from a small set of basic tools for multimodal search agents. This helps agents adapt when they face new kinds of questions, evidence, or failures, instead of relying on a fixed tool library. Across three in-domain and ten out-of-domain benchmarks, it improved performance over the base tools, as judged by a vision-language model. Larger backbone models gained more from the approach, suggesting that it scales well.

zh.title: 让智能体自造工具，灵活应对多模态搜索
zh.desc: 许多多模态搜索智能体依赖人工设计的工具库，但维护成本高，也难以应对新的问题类型和证据形式。ToolSmith 提出一种自动生成工具的框架，能在精简的基础工具库之上组合并扩展模块，并在不同任务中重复使用。研究在三个领域内和十个领域外的多模态搜索基准上进行评估，结果显示它能持续提升不同规模智能体的表现。较大的视觉语言模型从中获益更多，说明这种方法具有良好的扩展性。

papers.title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
papers.abstract: Abstract  Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing its count, then deploys a fresh Raspberry Pi node and live-migrates the agent onto it, in under four minutes of wall-clock time and \$0.13 of model usage. This extended version adds what the two-page demonstration paper could not: the Wiring view of the topic graph, Wactorz as a library for hand-written agents, how trained models are stored, sent to nodes and replaced, the security model, and the system's limitations.

ru.title: Агенты, которые живут месяцами и чинят себя сами
ru.desc: Статья представляет Wactorz — открытый runtime, в котором агенты на базе LLM реализованы как долгоживущие супервизируемые акторы, которые создаются во время работы из Python-кода, сгенерированного планировщиком по запросу в чате. Супервизор перезапускает упавший актор с сохранением его состояния, а вся координация идёт через MQTT, что позволяет запускать агенты и переносить их между edge-узлами, например Raspberry Pi, без остановки. В демонстрации автоматизация «камера — лампа» создаётся одним запросом, а второй агент, намеренно содержащий деление на ноль, самостоятельно исправляет свой код без потери состояния. Расширенная версия добавляет визуализацию графа топиков, использование Wactorz как библиотеки, хранение и замену обученных моделей, модель безопасности и ограничения системы.

en.title: Agents That Keep Going, Even When They Move
en.desc: Wactorz is an open-source runtime for long-lived LLM agents that operate in physical environments and on nearby edge hardware. A planner turns chat requests into Python actors, while a supervisor can restart a crashed actor without losing its state. Agents coordinate through MQTT topics and can be moved between devices such as Raspberry Pis. The paper describes a demonstration and additional system features, including topic-graph visualization, model deployment, security, and limitations.

zh.title: 让智能体持久运行：故障可恢复，边缘可迁移
zh.desc: Wactorz 是一个用于长期运行 LLM 智能体的开源运行时，适合家庭、实验室和工厂等物理环境。规划器会把聊天请求转成 Python 代码，并在运行时编译成新的智能体；监督器则能在智能体崩溃后单独重启它，同时保留其状态。系统通过 MQTT 协调智能体，使它们能在边缘设备上启动、迁移，并让外部系统订阅内部事件。演示展示了智能体自动修复代码、保留计数状态并迁移到树莓派节点；扩展版本还介绍了主题连线视图、手写智能体库、模型管理、安全机制与系统局限。

papers.title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
papers.abstract: Abstract PersistWorld maintains a scene-anchored 3D world state updated from camera streams and forecasts future semantic occupancy more accurately and faster than prior camera-based world models.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Запоминать увиденное, а не пересчитывать его заново
ru.desc: PersistWorld — это camera-based world model для прогнозирования 4D occupancy в автономном вождении, которая хранит в памяти постоянное 3D-состояние сцены, привязанное к пространству. Вместо того чтобы пересобирать состояние из прошлых кадров, модель записывает каждый кадр в это состояние однократно и обучает его end-to-end вместе с прогнозом. Эволвер предсказывает состояние в любой момент времени вдоль траектории ego-автомобиля, что помогает удерживать уже увиденную, неизменившуюся часть пространства. На Occ3D-nuScenes модель повышает IoU лучшей камерной world model на 18-24 пункта и работает более чем вдвое быстрее.

en.title: Remember the World, Forecast What Comes Next
en.desc: PersistWorld forecasts future 3D semantic occupancy in driving scenes from camera streams. It stores observed information in a persistent, scene-anchored world state instead of repeatedly rebuilding the scene from past frames. A learned evolver predicts that state at queried times along the vehicle’s trajectory, helping the model retain what it has already seen. On Occ3D-nuScenes, it improves occupancy IoU over the strongest prior camera-based model and runs more than twice as fast.

zh.title: 记住已见世界，让未来预测更准更快
zh.desc: 本文研究自动驾驶场景中的4D占用预测，即预测未来时刻三维空间各处的语义类别。作者发现，现有模型的主要问题不是预测哪些地方会变化，而是无法稳定保留已经观测到的场景信息。为此，PersistWorld 将摄像头画面逐帧写入以场景为锚点的持久化三维世界状态，并通过演化模块预测车辆行驶轨迹上任意时刻的场景状态。它在 Occ3D-nuScenes 数据集上显著提升了预测准确率，最长可预测至8秒，运行速度也超过以往最佳摄像头模型的两倍。

papers.title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract ReWeave jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights, improving success and enabling continual learning across tasks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups (0.34times full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.

ru.title: Учимся на взаимодействии, а не на перевеса весов
ru.desc: В статье представлен фреймворк ReWeave, который совместно оптимизирует harness для embodied-агента и эмерджентную топологию физических задач на основе взаимодействия с окружением, не обновляя веса policy. Замороженные политики исполнения и perception дополняются координированной оптимизацией контекста, workflow и control loops, а новые данные пересматривают топологию и переносят прошлые trial'ы на обновлённое понимание задачи. Такой подход позволяет выявлять частичный прогресс, регрессии и bottleneck'и, направляя выбор родителей и ширину поиска, а также консолидировать 72 специализированных модуля в 44 переиспользуемые группы. ReWeave заметно повышает успешность на LIBERO-PRO и RoboDojo, а общий harness демонстрирует лучший перенос на новые задачи и continual learning.

en.title: Learn the task structure, reuse what works
en.desc: ReWeave improves an embodied agent by jointly refining its harness and a physical task topology learned from interaction, without changing the policy or perception weights. The topology represents physical dependencies and is updated as new evidence reveals which preconditions and mechanisms matter. ReWeave revisits earlier trials using this updated understanding to identify retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks, guiding search and reuse across tasks. It improves success on benchmark tasks and supports continual learning, while combining specialist units into a more compact shared harness.

zh.title: 不改策略权重，让交互经验织成可迁移的任务框架
zh.desc: ReWeave让具身智能体通过与环境交互，同时优化运行框架和逐步形成的物理任务关系图，但不更新策略网络的权重。它把已验证的操作方法与尚未满足的物理条件对应起来，并重新分析过去的试验，从而发现进展、退步和任务瓶颈。这样既能把不同任务中的专门方法整理成可复用模块，也能支持跨任务迁移和持续学习。在实验中，ReWeave提升了多个基准任务的成功率；在LIBERO-PRO的未见任务上，持续学习后成功率达到75.0%。

papers.title: WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit. To address this challenge, we introduce WeaveVLA, a framework that enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations. WeaveVLA employs a task-conditioned sparse graph neural network to encode relative 3D relations among objects, the gripper, and nearby references. Pair-specific recurrent edge states integrate geometric evidence across observations to maintain evolving spatial context. A learned-query readout summarizes the updated graph representations into compact relational tokens, which condition the action expert alongside the original vision-language context. An auxiliary geometry reconstruction objective further encourages spatial structure preservation. We instantiate WeaveVLA on StarVLA-GR00T and π_{0.5}, achieving over 98\% average success on LIBERO with both backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, WeaveVLA improves success from 74.9\% to 82.0\% and from 85.7\% to 87.8\%, respectively, with additional improvements on CALVIN DrightarrowD. On three real-world tasks, the StarVLA-GR00T-based variant improves average success from 55.6\% to 70.0\% under standard conditions and from 33.3\% to 53.3\% under OOD perturbations, surpassing the π_{0.5} baseline in both settings.

ru.title: Явные 3D-связи помогают роботу не терять пространственный контекст при манипуляциях
ru.desc: В статье представлен WeaveVLA — фреймворк, который дополняет модели vision-language-action (VLA) явным моделированием относительных 3D-отношений между объектами, захватом робота и опорными точками. Для этого используется task-conditioned sparse graph neural network с рекуррентными состояниями рёбер, которые накапливают геометрическую информацию по последовательности наблюдений. Полученные графовые представления сворачиваются в компактные relational tokens и подаются в action expert вместе с исходным контекстом vision-language. Вспомогательная задача реконструкции геометрии помогает сохранять пространственную структуру, а результаты на LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN и трёх реальных задачах показывают заметный рост успешности, в том числе в условиях OOD-возмущений.

en.title: Track 3D Relations to Guide Better Robot Actions
en.desc: WeaveVLA improves vision-language-action models by explicitly representing the 3D relationships between objects, the robot gripper, and nearby reference points. A task-conditioned sparse graph neural network encodes these relationships, while recurrent edge states track how they change across observations. The resulting relational tokens guide action generation alongside the original vision and language context, and an auxiliary objective helps preserve spatial structure. Experiments show higher success rates across simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks, including under out-of-distribution perturbations.

zh.title: 让机器人看懂并记住操作中的三维关系
zh.desc: WeaveVLA是一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，旨在让机器人更明确地理解操作任务中的三维空间关系。它用任务条件化的稀疏图神经网络表示物体、夹爪及周围参照物之间的相对位置，并通过循环边状态整合多次观测的信息。模型将更新后的图表示汇总为关系令牌，与原有视觉-语言信息一起输入动作生成模块，同时利用几何重建辅助目标保留空间结构。在LIBERO、CALVIN和真实机器人任务上的实验显示，该方法提升了多种模型的成功率，尤其在真实环境和分布外扰动下表现更好。

papers.title: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
papers.abstract: Abstract MORSE leverages recurring failures to search for adaptable methods and pretrained perception models, improving accuracy and speed of a frozen video-language model on streaming video question answering.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.

ru.title: Повторяющиеся ошибки — ключ к самоулучшению видеопамяти
ru.desc: Статья представляет MORSE — фреймворк автоматического исследования (open-world auto-research), который использует повторяющиеся ошибки для поиска решений в памяти стриминговой video-language модели, например LLM-агента на базе Qwen3-VL-8B. Редактор группирует ошибки по причинам, ищет методы в статьях, model cards и коде, а также подключает готовые perception-модели. Затем он оптимизирует harness хранения и поиска кадров при замороженном backbone, сначала повышая точность ответов, а затем ускоряя систему в заданных пределах допуска. На бенчмарке OVO-Bench метод достигает точности 75.1% при среднем времени ответа 0.30 секунды, опережая ближайший аналог на 3.1 процентных пункта.

en.title: Turn recurring failures into faster, more accurate video answers
en.desc: MORSE improves streaming video question answering by updating the system that selects and stores video evidence for a frozen video-language model. It groups repeated errors by their likely cause, then searches research papers, model cards, and code for methods or pretrained perception models that could address them. It evaluates proposed changes on held-out streams, first favoring higher answer accuracy and then seeking faster methods that retain those gains. Across three benchmarks, MORSE achieves the highest accuracy among systems using the same frozen backbone; on OVO-Bench, it reaches 75.1% accuracy with an average response time of 0.30 seconds.

zh.title: 从反复失败中寻找方案，让流式视频问答更准更快
zh.desc: MORSE 是一种开放式自动研究框架，旨在提升流式视频问答系统的表现。它会归纳训练过程中反复出现的错误，并搜索论文、模型说明和代码，寻找可借鉴的方法或可用的预训练感知模型。加入新的感知能力后，MORSE 还会调整证据的存储与检索方式，同时保持视频语言模型参数冻结。实验中，它在三个基准上都取得了同等冻结骨干模型比较中的最高准确率；在 OVO-Bench 上，问答准确率为 75.1%，平均耗时 0.30 秒。

papers.title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
papers.abstract: Abstract Feedback Shortcut reduces speculative decoding errors caused by feeding top-layer hidden states back into Transformer inputs by aligning projected states and correcting drafts with predecessor states, preserving exact-decoding quality while accelerating decoding.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within 10^{-4} bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

ru.title: Быстрая генерация без потери качества: обратная связь, которая не тормозит декодирование
ru.desc: Статья посвящена ускорению декодирования Transformer-моделей с обратной связью по скрытым состояниям верхнего слоя, которая ломает speculative decoding. Авторы предлагают Feedback Shortcut: state alignment обучает лёгкую проекцию из состояний multi-token prediction head в приближённые заменители обратной связи, не трогая обучение базовой модели. Второй компонент, pipelined correction, пересчитывает каждый черновик с использованием нового состояния предшествующего токена, что повышает точность без дополнительных вызовов модели. Метод сохраняет качество exact decoding и ускоряет генерацию в 2.4–2.8 раза при небольшом росте вычислений на обучение.

en.title: Faster Speculative Decoding, Near Exact Quality
en.desc: The paper introduces Feedback Shortcut, a method for making speculative decoding work with Transformers that feed hidden states back into their inputs. A lightweight projection aligns multi-token prediction head states with the feedback states needed to draft tokens, without changing base-model training. During verification, pipelined correction uses each draft token’s predecessor state to refine the draft, adding no extra model calls. Experiments show decoding speeds up by 2.4–2.8× while staying very close to exact-decoding quality, with only about 2% more training compute.

zh.title: 对齐状态、校正草稿，让推测解码又快又准
zh.desc: 论文研究一种在 Transformer 中使用隐藏状态反馈、同时支持推测解码的方法。为避免训练时适配近似反馈损害模型表现，作者提出状态对齐：用轻量投影将多 token 预测头的状态映射为反馈所需的替代状态。推测解码时，流水线校正会利用前一个位置新计算出的状态重新评估草稿 token，从而减少近似误差，而且无需额外调用模型。在实验中，该方法的质量接近精确解码，并将解码速度提升约 2.4 至 2.8 倍。

papers.title: Typhoon OCR 2: From Thai Document Transcription to Multilingual, Multi-Task OCR
papers.abstract: Abstract  Typhoon OCR 1.5 focused on reading Thai documents. However, in real-world workflows, users often need to extract specific information or preserve the structure of an entire page for further processing. Typhoon OCR 2 handles both tasks in a single model, with prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing. Full-page parsing covers Thai, English, and Chinese. We release compact 2B and 0.8B models adapted from open document parsers through supervised fine-tuning on curated Thai and public multilingual data, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task rewards and a rule penalizing unfinished responses. Among evaluated open models, Typhoon OCR 2 2B scores highest on Thai MDPBench (80.7 versus 68.9 for Typhoon OCR 1.5) and on ThaiOCRBench (59.91 versus 40.45), which covers recognition, extraction, and document understanding. The 2B model remains close to its base on English olmOCR-bench (84.7 versus 84.4) and on OmniDocBench, which evaluates English and Chinese together (90.97 versus 91.03). On MDPBench, GRPO reduces the mean share of pages with repetition loops for the 2B model from 3.2% to 0.7%, with a smaller and statistically uncertain score gain for the 0.8B model. We release the model weights, Python package, and evaluation suite.

ru.title: Один OCR-ассистент для тайских документов: извлечение и разбор страниц в одной модели
ru.desc: Typhoon OCR 2 — это компактная мультимодальная LLM для распознавания документов, которая объединяет извлечение отдельной информации по промпту и структурированный разбор всей страницы в одной модели. Модель обучена на тайском, английском и китайском языках через supervised fine-tuning с последующей оптимизацией GRPO, где используются награды за качество задачи и штраф за незавершённые ответы. Версия 2B превосходит предыдущую версию 1.5 и другие открытые модели на тайских бенчмарках MDPBench и ThaiOCRBench, а на английском и китайском сохраняет уровень базовой модели. GRPO также заметно снижает долю страниц с зацикливанием повторов, с 3.2% до 0.7%, а модели и инструменты оценки опубликованы в открытом доступе.

en.title: One compact model for targeted extraction and structured document parsing
en.desc: Typhoon OCR 2 is a document-understanding model that can extract requested information from prompts or parse a whole page into structured data. It supports Thai, English, and Chinese full-page parsing, and comes in compact 2B and 0.8B versions. The models are trained with supervised fine-tuning and then optimized using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task rewards and a penalty for unfinished responses. The 2B model improves substantially over Typhoon OCR 1.5 on Thai benchmarks while staying close to its base model on English and Chinese tests; GRPO also reduces repetitive output loops.

zh.title: 一个模型，同时完成文档信息提取与整页解析
zh.desc: Typhoon OCR 2 是一个能识别泰文、英文和中文文档的模型，既能按提示提取指定信息，也能解析整页结构。研究者以精选泰文数据和公开多语言数据进行监督微调，再用带有任务奖励和未完成输出惩罚的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）训练模型。评测中，2B 版本在泰文基准上的表现优于先前版本，同时在英文和中英文基准上接近基础模型；GRPO 也减少了重复输出。研究者公开了模型权重、Python 工具包和评测套件。

papers.title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
papers.abstract: Abstract A sample-efficient curation method and a structure-aware layout metric enable a fine-tuned vision-language model to improve OCR on challenging financial document patterns, achieving high word recall and document question-answering F1.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows. These patterns include vertical or rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts. While underrepresented in public datasets, they constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases. We introduce SAVIOR, a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets such high-impact failure scenarios to adapt vision-language models for robust financial OCR. We further propose PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity by comparing pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves a word recall of 0.93. When the resulting layout-aware OCR output is used as context for document question answering, it attains an F1 score of 0.89, outperforming both open- and closed-source models such as GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR.

ru.title: Умный отбор данных делает OCR финансовых документов точнее
ru.desc: Авторы показывают, что современные OCR-системы и vision-language модели плохо распознают важные для финансов элементы документов, такие как повернутый текст, логотипы, мелкий шрифт и сложные многоколоночные макеты. Для адаптации модели Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct они предлагают метод SAVIOR, который отбирает небольшой и целенаправленный обучающий набор из проблемных примеров. Для оценки качества сохранения структуры документа вводится метрика PaIRS, сравнивающая попарные пространственные отношения между токенами. Дообученная модель достигает word recall 0.93, а при использовании её OCR-вывода как контекста для document QA F1 составляет 0.89, что выше GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL и DeepSeek-OCR.

en.title: Curate for the Hard Cases, Capture the Document Structure
en.desc: The paper introduces SAVIOR, a data curation method that selects a small number of examples targeting difficult financial document patterns. Fine-tuning a vision-language model on this curated data improves OCR for rotated text, logos, fine print, degraded scans, and complex layouts. The authors also propose PaIRS, a structure-aware metric that evaluates whether the spatial relationships between recognized tokens match the document layout. Their fine-tuned model achieves 0.93 word recall, and its OCR output supports document question answering with an F1 score of 0.89.

zh.title: 精准筛选难例，让金融文档识别更懂布局
zh.desc: 论文指出，现有光学字符识别（OCR）和视觉语言模型在金融文档中容易漏掉旋转文字、标志中的供应商名称、细小条款及复杂栏布局等内容。研究提出 SAVIOR，一种样本高效的数据筛选方法，重点收集这些重要但少见的困难案例，用于微调模型。研究还设计了 PaIRS 指标，通过比较文字之间的空间关系来评估识别结果是否保留了文档布局。使用 SAVIOR-Train 微调 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 后，词语召回率达到 0.93，并在文档问答任务中取得 0.89 的 F1 分数，优于论文中比较的多种模型。

papers.title: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
papers.abstract: Abstract A unified power-law scoring rule for cache eviction calibrates one exponent per model and yields a method that improves language-model perplexity and preserves question-answering accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash The decay exponent α in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as s_i = A_i cdot (t-i)^{-α}, where A_i is cumulative attention and α controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to α=0 and αtoinfty, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch).   The no-hair mechanism of xiang2026nohair bounds the admissible range of α, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields [0.556, 0.822] for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps.   NoHairCache achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM (p < 0.05 on all three datasets, with 0.06--0.10 PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget 512). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining 98.2% of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at 25% retention versus 91.1% for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.

ru.title: Один параметр затухания для всех доменов: умное вытеснение KV-кэша без лишней настройки
ru.desc: Статья предлагает единую степенную функцию оценки токенов для вытеснения KV-кэша в языковых моделях: показано, что H2O и StreamingLLM являются крайними случаями одного семейства с параметром затухания α. Значение α калибруется один раз для каждой модели на одном корпусе (WikiText) и затем переносится на другие домены без дополнительной настройки. Метод NoHairCache демонстрирует наименьшую perplexity на WikiText, PG19 и arXiv и сохраняет точность в задачах question answering, например 98.2% от полного кэша на NarrativeQA при 25% удержании. Авторы утверждают, что найденные диапазоны α согласуются между пятью моделями размером 410M–1.5B и совпадают с оптимальными областями из перебора perplexity.

en.title: One Calibrated Rule for Smarter KV-Cache Eviction
en.desc: The paper proposes a unified way to rank tokens for removal from a language model’s KV cache, combining attention importance with token age. Its power-law scoring rule connects H2O and StreamingLLM as two extreme cases, with an exponent calibrated once for each model on a single dataset. The calibrated method, NoHairCache, achieves lower perplexity than those baselines across three datasets without dataset-specific tuning. It also matches or exceeds StreamingLLM on the tested question-answering tasks, though those results are not statistically conclusive.

zh.title: 一次校准模型的遗忘节奏，让 KV 缓存跨领域更高效
zh.desc: 论文提出一种统一的 KV 缓存淘汰方法，用同一个幂律评分规则连接基于注意力的 H2O 与基于近期性的 StreamingLLM。规则为每个缓存 token 结合累积注意力和 token 年龄打分，其中指数 α 控制对旧 token 的惩罚；作者发现 α 是模型自身的属性，只需在一个语料上校准，就能迁移到其他领域。实验显示，该方法在 WikiText、PG19 和 arXiv 上取得更低的语言模型困惑度，且无需针对不同数据集调参。在多项选择问答任务中，它的准确率与 StreamingLLM 相当或更好，说明降低缓存占用时仍能较好保留问答能力。

papers.title: Prism: Hierarchical Text Detection with Minimalist Design
papers.abstract: Abstract  Hierarchical text detection aims to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs while parsing their structural relationships. It provides essential structural cues for visual text understanding. To maximize accuracy, existing methods typically rely on complex multi-scale feature fusion necks and heavy-weight heads, resulting in bloated architectures and low inference efficiency. In this paper, we argue that a sufficiently pre-trained backbone can effectively replace these sophisticated external modules, while simple geometric inclusion suffices for hierarchical text structural parsing. Thus, we propose Prism, a minimalist framework for hierarchical text detection. Prism performs multi-granularity detection by attaching parallel lightweight heads to a single-scale backbone feature map, covering words, text lines, and paragraphs, and reconstructs the structural hierarchy via an efficient geometric inclusion algorithm. In addition, we systematically compare representative lightweight head archetypes and show that pixel-level regression offers the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off in this setting. Experiments on multiple public benchmarks show that our significantly simplified architecture achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkable efficiency. Specifically, it runs 1.7times faster than LRANet on CTW1500 while achieving higher accuracy, and surpasses the current SOTA method, OmniParser V2, by over 6 PQ points on the hierarchical HierText dataset. Code will be released soon.

ru.title: Простота побеждает: сильный backbone заменяет сложные модули в иерархическом детектировании текста
ru.desc: В статье предлагается Prism — минималистичная архитектура для иерархического детектирования текста, которая находит слова, строки и абзацы и восстанавливает их структурную иерархию. Вместо сложных многомасштабных necks и тяжёлых голов модель использует предобученный backbone с одной картой признаков и параллельные легковесные головы. Иерархия строится простым геометрическим алгоритмом включения ограничивающих рамок. Эксперименты показывают SOTA-качество при заметно более высокой скорости инференса, чем у LRANet и OmniParser V2.

en.title: Simpler Architecture, Stronger Hierarchical Text Detection
en.desc: Prism is a minimalist framework for detecting words, text lines, and paragraphs in images. It uses a single-scale feature map from a pre-trained backbone with parallel, lightweight detection heads, instead of complex multi-scale feature fusion and heavy heads. A geometric inclusion algorithm then reconstructs the structural relationships between detected text regions, and experiments find pixel-level regression gives the best balance of accuracy and efficiency. On public benchmarks, Prism achieves state-of-the-art results, running 1.7 times faster than LRANet on CTW1500 and exceeding OmniParser V2 by over 6 PQ points on HierText.

zh.title: 简化架构，精准解析文本层级
zh.desc: 论文提出了 Prism，一种用于分层文本检测的简洁框架，可定位单词、文本行和段落。它在单尺度骨干网络特征上连接多个轻量级检测头，并通过几何包含关系重建文本的层级结构。研究比较了多种轻量级检测头，发现像素级回归在准确率与效率之间取得了最佳平衡。在多个公开基准上，Prism 达到领先性能；例如，它在 CTW1500 上比 LRANet 快 1.7 倍且准确率更高，并在 HierText 上比 OmniParser V2 高出 6 个以上 PQ 点。

papers.title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
papers.abstract: Abstract  Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? In MobileGym, we adjust each dimension separately, train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, and evaluate every policy in the original full environment. A verifier that rewards only one reference path lowers success by 10.53 points, and removing unneeded records also lowers success. Pruning unneeded features instead raises success from 51.61% to 56.13%, entirely on tasks whose environments it left unchanged. The gain reverses when each episode is weighted equally and vanishes when only episodes on the pruned tasks are balanced. Without pruning, length weighting there reinforces long detour successes that erode skills on other tasks. Following these findings, we build MobileGym-Lite, which keeps reward and data coverage complete and prunes unneeded features. It outperforms Full in the full environment (55.48% versus 51.61% success) with lower construction cost.

ru.title: Меньше — значит лучше: обрезка лишних функций ускоряет обучение GUI-агентов
ru.desc: В статье исследуется, насколько полной должна быть среда для обучения GUI-агентов с помощью обучения с подкреплением. Авторы выделяют три измерения полноты: покрытие наград (reward coverage), покрытие данных (data coverage) и покрытие функций (feature coverage). В MobileGym они по отдельности изменяют каждое измерение, обучают Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct и оценивают политики в полной среде. Результаты показывают, что удаление ненужных функций повышает успешность с 51.61% до 56.13%, а на основе этих выводов построена облегчённая среда MobileGym-Lite, которая превосходит полную среду при меньших затратах на создание.

en.title: Build leaner GUI environments without sacrificing agent capability
en.desc: This paper studies how the completeness of training environments affects GUI agents, focusing on reward coverage, data coverage, and feature coverage. In MobileGym, the researchers vary each dimension and train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, then evaluate the agents in the original full environment. Narrowing the verifier’s rewarded paths or removing irrelevant app data reduces success, while pruning unused features can improve it, though the result depends on how episodes are weighted. Based on these findings, MobileGym-Lite preserves complete rewards and data while pruning unused features, achieving 55.48% success versus 51.61% for the full environment at lower construction cost.

zh.title: 保留关键覆盖，精简无关功能，让 GUI 智能体训练更高效
zh.desc: 论文研究如何构建低成本的图形用户界面（GUI）训练环境，并分析环境完整度对智能体训练效果的影响。作者在 MobileGym 中分别调整奖励覆盖、数据覆盖和功能覆盖，并用 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 训练智能体，再在完整环境中评估。结果显示，只奖励一条参考操作路径或删除任务未用到的数据都会降低成功率；而剪除未用到的功能可提升总体成功率，但效果会受任务和评估加权方式影响。基于此，作者构建 MobileGym-Lite，保留完整的奖励与数据覆盖、精简无关功能，以更低成本取得优于完整环境的表现。

papers.title: Fast-JEPA: Advancing the Success-Latency Frontier for Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Fast-JEPA is a latent world model planning framework that improves the success-latency trade-off of predictive search by predicting complete action-sequence outcomes and using goal-directed plans, with evaluation on manipulation and navigation tasks and a new dynamic planning benchmark.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Latent world models predict the outcomes of action sequences, but comparing candidate plans through recursive rollout remains expensive at test time. We introduce Fast-JEPA, a latent world model planning framework that advances the success-latency Pareto frontier of predictive search. Fast-JEPA reorganizes predictive computation to support effective action-sequence search at low planning cost. It constructs a goal-directed plan to guide search and directly predicts the outcomes of complete candidates for efficient comparison, avoiding recursive state rollout during refinement. Across PushT, Reacher, Cube, and TwoRoom, Fast-JEPA achieves 96.50% average success rate with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT. Search-budget sweeps show that its competitive success and low latency extend across candidate counts and refinement depths. We further introduce DynaGoal, a benchmark for evaluating world-model planning under dynamic out-of-distribution conditions, execution deadlines, and controlled response delays. Fast-JEPA achieves average success rates of 73.83% on DynaGoal-Shift and 87.67% on DynaGoal-Deadline, demonstrating the practical value of low-latency predictive planning under changing control conditions and execution-time constraints. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sofilyzia/Fast-JEPA.

ru.title: Быстрое планирование в латентном мире: предсказываем исход сразу всей последовательности действий
ru.desc: Fast-JEPA — это фреймворк планирования на основе латентной world model, который ускоряет предиктивный поиск действий. Вместо рекурсивного rollout состояний модель строит целевой план и напрямую предсказывает итоговый результат полных кандидатов последовательностей действий, что позволяет быстро их сравнивать. На задачах PushT, Reacher, Cube и TwoRoom метод достигает среднего success rate 96.50% и планирует в 2.41 раза быстрее INTACT. Также авторы представляют бенчмарк DynaGoal для оценки планирования в динамических out-of-distribution условиях с дедлайнами и задержками.

en.title: Plan the Whole Sequence, Reach the Goal Faster
en.desc: Fast-JEPA is a latent world model planning method that predicts what will happen after complete action sequences. It uses a goal-directed plan to guide its search and avoids repeatedly simulating each step, making plan comparison faster. On several manipulation and navigation tasks, it achieved a 96.50% average success rate and planned 2.41 times faster than INTACT. The paper also introduces DynaGoal, a benchmark for testing planning under changing conditions and time limits, where Fast-JEPA performed well.

zh.title: 直接预测完整计划，让潜在世界模型规划更快、更可靠
zh.desc: Fast-JEPA 是一种基于潜在世界模型的规划框架，用于预测一系列动作可能带来的结果。它先生成面向目标的计划，再直接预测完整候选动作序列的结果，从而避免在搜索过程中反复递归推演状态。与 INTACT 相比，它在 PushT、Reacher、Cube 和 TwoRoom 任务中平均成功率达到 96.50%，规划速度提高 2.41 倍。论文还提出 DynaGoal 基准，用于测试动态环境、执行时限和响应延迟下的规划能力；Fast-JEPA 在其中也取得了较高成功率。

papers.title: Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values
papers.abstract: Abstract Paired non-contrast and contrast-enhanced medical images reveal that visual content retrieved through value vectors, rather than spatial attention alone, is critical for multimodal model perception, motivating a distillation method that improves non-contrast inference.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID.
